name: Send Bulk Email – Set User Role, Trigger Count and Email Log
author: eGrove Systems

sections.description:
Bulk Email Sender by EGS allows you to send bulk emails efficiently to selected users.
It supports email queuing, rate limiting, and detailed logging.

Free Features:
* Send unlimited emails for subscribers with the user role.

Premium Features:
* Limit emails per minute and per hour to match your hosting provider’s capabilities.
* Detailed logs for sent and pending emails.
* Multiple user role selection with a media-rich visual editor.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
For more details, visit GNU General Public License.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external service for license validation.

  • Service Name: eGrove Systems Licensing API
  • Purpose: Used to validate and deactivate the plugin license.
  • Data Sent: The plugin sends the license key and site URL during activation and deactivation.
  • When Data is Sent:
    • License validation occurs when activating or deactivating the plugin.
    • A request is sent to confirm the validity of the license.
  • Service URL: https://www.modulebazaar.com/
  • Terms of Service: Terms & Conditions
  • Privacy Policy: Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings page to configure your email limits and SMTP settings.
sections.faq:
How do I configure email limits?

You can set email limits in the plugin settings under “Emails Per Minute” and “Emails Per Hour”.

Does it support third-party SMTP servers?

Yes, you can configure SMTP settings using a compatible plugin, like WP Mail SMTP.
